paite: Mihing pautuamte leh angel pautuamte in thu gen mah leng, itna ka neih keileh dak ging lel hiam, dakkhutbet ging lel hiam ka hi ding hi.
heading: Thilpiak Lianpen Itna Ahi

paite: Huan thugenkholh theihna nei in, thuguk tengteng leh theihna tengteng thei vek in, mual suantheihna khop hial ginna kim nei mah leng, itna ka neih keileh bangmah ka hi kei hi.
Huan migentheite vakna ding in ka sum tengteng pe vek in, ka pumpi leng kang ding hial in kipe mah leng, itna ka neih keileh kei a ding in bangmah aphatuam kei hi.
Itna in adohzou a, amigi a; itna in ahaza kei a, akisathei sam kei;
itna aki-uangsak kei a, ahuham sam kei. Amah thu achi tentun kei a, ahehbaih kei, hehsa in a-omden sam kei;
itna in gilou akipahpih kei a, adik akipahpih zaw hi.
Itna in bangkim athuak teitei a, bangkim agingta a, bangkim alamen a, bangkim athuakkhe zel hi.
Itna zaw chikchiang mah in abei kei ding; himahleh, thugenkholhnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding a, pautuamte om mahleh ahong tawp ding a, theihnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding.
Akim lou in i thei ua, akim lou in thu i gen uhi.
Akim ahong tun chiang in akim lou hihtawp ahita ding.
Ka naupan lai in naupang pau in ka pau a, naupang theih in ka thei a, naupang ngaihtuah in ka ngaihtuah hi; tua ka hong pichin nung in naupang hihdan ka tawpsanta hi.

Tu in zaw limlang ah i mu milmial ahi, huai hun chiang in zaw kimaituah in ahita ding hi. Tu in zaw akim lou in ka thei a, himahleh huai hun chiang in zaw theih khit a ka om bang in ka theikimta ding hi.
Huchi in hiai thumte: ginna, lametna, itna, a-om gige ding ahi; himahleh hiaite a athupipen itna ahi.
